title: loss-decomp: move its set to one recall shard of MGnify, Swissprot, and pid's profmark set
body: Jack's call 29 Sep: once the depth analysis is finalised on the current 500k cross, loss-decomp's real set becomes three units: mgy at one recall shard's worth of MGnify (2,455,940 sequences, as stage-times-mgy), swissprot as now (maybe kept), and pid's profmark set at pid's own parameters. The pid unit is a different shape, so this is a union label like stage-times-real, with the cross for mgy and swissprot and the profmark recipe for pid. Expect roughly five times the MGnify work and the pid unit new; the current 500k cross took 69 minutes at 48 threads with s12 at 31 GB peak on MGnify and 42 GB on Swissprot.

notes.author: jackroddy/924b3ec0
notes.text: Jack 30 Sep: the set is Pfam x one recall shard's worth of MGnify (2,455,940 seqs) and nothing else; no swissprot, no pid unit. The 500k cross and its runs (105 GB) were deleted and loss-decomp-real rebuilt under the new recipe; the toy follows the same shape at 50,000 seqs.
